definitions.meaning: To bear or carry forth, bring forth, bring forward, produce

quotations.old_english: Ðone æðelan Albanum seó wæstmberende Bryton forþbereþ
Ðætte ealle openlíce be heora dǽde þurh andetnesse forþbǽron
quotations.latin: ut omnes pălam quæ gessĕrant confĭtendo proferrent

quotations.old_english: Ðæt he gewitnesse forþbǽre be ðam leóhte

source_text: forþ-beran; he -bereþ, -bireþ; p. -bær, pl. -bǽron; pp. -boren To bear or carry forth, bring forth, bring forward, produce; proferre, perh&i-short;b&e-long;re :-- Ðone æðelan Albanum seó wæstmberende Bryton forþbereþ Alb&a-long;num egr&e-short;gium f&e-long;cunda Britannia profert, Bd. 1, 7; S. 476, 34. Ðætte ealle openlíce be heora dǽde þurh andetnesse forþbǽron ut omnes p&a-short;lam quæ gess&e-short;rant conf&i-short;tendo proferrent, 4, 27; S. 604, 23: Blickl. Homl. 25, 2; 101, 30. Ðæt he gewitnesse forþbǽre be ðam leóhte ut test&i-short;m&o-long;nium perh&i-short;b&e-long;ret de l&u-long;m&i-short;ne, Jn. Bos. 1. 8.
